The Yale team, observing this catastrophic failure, dynamically updated their strategic model, recognizing a sudden vulnerability in the opponent's formation. This adversarial inference loop—where one agent's physical breakdown becomes another's informational advantage—is central to our game-theoretic formulations of competitive dynamics.
